title: A place for memory and letters
description: Entries, photographs and things left unsaid can be kept at your own pace.

blocks.text: A person may want to write about a loss, or address the memory of someone close, without any public discussion.

quote.text: Since my son passed away, this app is my faithful companion, I write in it every day, my day to day without him.

blocks.text: Offer a free entry, dates of your own and a review of memories you control. Make prompts and notifications optional.
There is no need to put a deadline on what a person is going through, or to judge how correctly they keep their journal.
